_why: Game systems' entries and tiles whose vdata names no art of their own (tools/extract_icons.py game_icons, review 2026-10-05: Game tiles and groups were site glyphs). Each gets the art the game itself shows for that same thing elsewhere: its minimap marker, its ping-wheel icon (scripts/ping_wheel_messages.vdata), its HUD icon. Rules are regexes on '<file>:<id>', first match wins; an entry's own art from the vdata always wins. Paths are under panorama/images/ as Source2Viewer-CLI extracts them (a .psd/.png becomes <name>_psd.png / <name>_png.png). A minimap marker drawn small on an empty canvas is cut to its art (TRIM_BELOW). Nothing here is drawn or fetched: where no game art fits, the site keeps its pixel glyph (AGENTS rule 8).
_why_systems: Art for the Game index tiles and system page heads (game_systems.json 'icon': 'game/<name>'): the crate the minimap marks crate spawns with (Breakables & crates), the level-up icon the HUD shows for a new ability point (Hero progression), Street Brawl's own HUD icon (Modes: its only mode), the Soul Urn as the minimap shows it (Urn & Unstable Rift; its old icon was ability_golden_idol's, which the files borrow from Wraith's Telekinesis).

the Urn going back: its return marker
the souls an Urn delivery pays
the Soul Urn on the minimap
carrying / picking up the Soul Urn
